mid.text: Sigarda is the angel who lifts people from despair and gives them strength to fight on, and when Olivia Voldaren disturbs the Dawnhart ritual and begins the Eternal Night, she captures Sigarda and plans to marry Edgar Markov to control the bloodlines. Meanwhile, Sigarda and Sorin battle while Arlinn and Teferi recover the key from the Markov catacombs.

Sigarda appears when Sorin refuses to give up the Key and strikes Arlinn, stopping his attack so the group can take it, and she tells them where the Key is while she battles him. Later Sorin's attack on Olivia awakens Katilda's spirit from the Key, which frees the captive Sigarda.

The Gatewatch and the coven's spirit foil Olivia, who flees, and the ritual ends the Eternal Night. In the Battle of Thraben, a coalition defeats Emrakul's Eldrazi and Nahiri's cultists after Sigarda kills Brisela, and Emrakul is imprisoned in Innistrad's Moon.
